title: meat tenderizer
text: meat tenderizer. Is very heavy, as you would expect... and does a great job - as described.  I hand wash unless I use the pokey side... So far, so good.  I haven't ever owned one of these, but started one of those food delivery services and this has come up several times... I tried using a glass... the side of plate... several different items... honestly... if it says you need a meat mallet... you need a meat mallet.  :)

product_metadata.title: OXO Meat Tenderizer
features: Tenderizer surface is textured for optimum use
Contoured, soft handle fits comfortably in your hand
Non-slip handles either wet or dry
